input.description: Six people are standing together, with one person seated in a wheelchair. They are dressed in formal and semi-formal attire. The man on the far left is wearing a blue suit with a white shirt and tie. Next to him, a man in a light-colored suit holds a white cane. A woman in a blue and white striped dress stands beside him, also holding a white cane. A man in a dark suit with a white shirt and no tie stands next to her. Another man in a black suit with a red tie is beside him. The man in the wheelchair is wearing a navy blue jacket with "USA" on it and is holding a gold medal. There are two banners on either side of the group with the "waymap" logo, QR codes, and the text "DOWNLOAD NOW."
all_user_responses: Today I was part of the WayMap app launch in Washington DC, and I was so excited that this picture was sent to me just a few minutes ago

So I am the woman in the blue and white striped dress holding a white cane. I want to make sure that my face is looking directly at the camera, that my belly is not poking out because I had eaten some hors d’oeuvres just before this picture was taken And am I smiling too hard?
This is so helpful, I just want to make sure that the coconut booties that I am wearing look good with the dress
Are you able to see the silver Tiffany stud earrings in both my ears or is my hair covering it on the right side?

Oh, I love that my hair didn’t cover my ears, I had not thought about it and thank goodness that the coconut booties do look good with the dress! Does my white cane seem to be covering any of my face?
What a relief! Just want to make sure there isn’t anything in my teeth because again, I was eating hors d’oeuvres before this picture was taken
It’s so important because I was going to ask about my posture and you said that my posture looks relaxed and confident and that’s exactly what I was going for
